spec.inner_cv: 5 folds; choose lambda by mean validation Harrell C-index
spec.interpretation: exploratory internal validation; not external validation; no causal claim
spec.label: POST-HOC EXPLORATORY PRETREATMENT-RNA LONG-TERM PROGNOSIS EXTENSION
spec.outer_cv: 5 repeats x 5 folds; shuffled KFold at patient level
spec.permutation: 200 one-sided whole-RNA-vector patient permutations; clinical/treatment/outcomes/timing fixed; outer-fold RNA-model lambdas are frozen to the values selected in the observed nested-CV run; success direction is null delta C-index >= observed
spec.preprocessing: fit within training fold only; age median imputation + missing indicator; ISS not_reported treated as missing category; gender/ISS/first_line one-hot; unknown validation categories map to all-zero; all resulting columns standardized using training-fold mean/SD before ridge fitting
spec.primary_cohort: one pre-treatment RNA unit per patient; inferred RNA day <= 0
spec.primary_metric: OOF Harrell C-index; delta = RNA - comparator
spec.rna_increment: fixed 50 Hallmark pathways used by existing Model D
spec.secondary_metric: IPCW IBS over 365-1095 days; delta = RNA - comparator
